editorial:
Imagine your family has owned a beautiful olive grove for hundreds of years, but money problems force them to sell their most prized tree. That is exactly what happens to Alma and her family in Spain. While her dad and uncle have moved on to raising chickens for money, Alma's grandfather is heartbroken. He has stopped speaking and eating because he misses that ancient tree so much. You will feel for Alma as she decides she cannot let her grandfather pass away feeling this sadness. She sets out on a wild, hopeful mission to find where the tree went and bring it back home, even if everyone else thinks she is being unrealistic.

The acting is great and the Spanish countryside looks stunning, which makes it a perfect pick for a cozy night in. The movie moves at a steady pace, blending some funny family arguments with really touching moments. Some might find the plot a bit slow, but the emotional payoff is totally worth it. If you want to see this in the best quality, you should try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video or renting it on Apple TV. Adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is also a smart move if you love beautiful scenery.
endingExplained: After a long search, Alma finally tracks down the ancient olive tree and manages to get it returned to the family land. Seeing the tree back in its rightful place brings her grandfather back to life emotionally. He finally starts eating and speaking again, finding peace in his final days. The family reconciles their differences, and the movie ends with a feeling of hope and healing for everyone involved.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about family bonds and fighting for what is right.
